statement: Exactly 79 finite genus-three subgroup classes contain a hyperelliptic involution: 18 positive and 61 mixed. The 61 mixed rows and all section posets are explicitly computed.
manuscript_passages: Part B(f) of the task; the genus-three hyperelliptic subcatalogue is an added result, not a further manuscript assertion
depends_on_doubtful_reading: None: the classification concerns the explicitly stated genus-three hyperelliptic subcatalogue.
notes: Executed regular coset representations, all relators and local injections, Euler characteristic -4, and eight fixed points of the deck involution. Does not assert completeness for finite subgroups not containing a hyperelliptic involution.
